mornings.message:
If you have documents (Aadhaar, ration card, land papers) and money, you could put them in a plastic bag. If you have grain and seed, you might store them up high. Plan where cattle will go; move them early to higher, safe ground away from hill slopes. Charge phones; keep a torch. Know your shelter: if you need one, consider a place away from rivers. Elderly, children, people who are ill: plan who helps them move. Stay away from rivers. Never cross flowing water. Call 1077 / 112 if water is rising.
